title: The Tense Tea Party
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure, Amuro/Bourbon, Officer Takagi) omitted by convention. The Rikumichi Kusuda / Black Organization subplot threaded through both episodes is unrelated to the tea-party murder and involves only recurring-cast characters, so it is omitted entirely. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old cases/ file correctly identified Juri Kosaka as the culprit (unlike several other rebuilt episodes) but spelled the co-suspect 'Katsuki Beppu' where on-screen captions in both episodes read 'Kazuki Beppu' -- corrected here. The old file's motive text for Kosaka ('resentment... and other unstated grievances') undersold the real driver: the transcript reveals Kosaka was pregnant when she caught the same influenza (passed son-to-son) and suffered a nervous breakdown and miscarriage, and that Suto had deliberately sent her sick son to study with Kosaka's son to sabotage his exam chances -- this, not just the failed exam, is the actual motive. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Lipstick on the right side of the cracked cup's handle, yet chopsticks (and presumably the cup) are normally held right-handed -- the victim was drinking left-handed, meaning her right hand was occupied (holding her phone) when she picked up the swapped cup.
The red stain on Kosaka's left-hand ring exactly matches the victim's lipstick shade -- proof Kosaka wiped incriminating lipstick off the swapped cup with her bare hand.

edges.detail: Suto knowingly sent the ill Tsuneo to study with Toji the day before the entrance exam, to eliminate an exam rival
Tsuneo passed his influenza to Toji, who then failed his entrance exam
Toji passed the influenza to Kosaka, who was pregnant; she had a nervous breakdown and miscarried
left the tea party briefly to use the restroom
left the tea party briefly to buy sweets, kept the receipt
laced cyanide on the rim before the other guests arrived, while Suto was out fetching hot water
swapped the teabag's contents to Butterfly Pea while keeping the Hibiscus wrapper
served a cup of disguised Butterfly Pea tea (o5 + o3) passed off as genuine Hibiscus tea
used the group's absorption in Suto's phone photos to cover the cup swap
swapped her poisoned cup (colored red with lemon) for Suto's disguised cup while both were absorbed in the phone photos

edges.method: cyanide poisoning via disguised, swapped teacup

edges.detail: Kosaka later admitted she hoped Beppu and Happo's alternating departures from the room would make them look guilty
